forms.label: Cone, unrefined
forms.sourceNote: Sugars, brown. Public domain. FoodData Central carries no dedicated piloncillo record; piloncillo is unrefined whole cane sugar boiled down and cast in a cone, compositionally close to the dark brown sugar this record covers, and closer to it than to any refined white sugar. The density is the solid-sugar class from density-classes.json, marked estimated, because the cone is grated or dissolved rather than poured.
